# Pixel Virtual Pet

A simple offline browser app featuring a CSS-drawn pixel pet with hunger, happiness, and energy bars. Use the Feed, Play, and Sleep buttons to interact.

## Features
- CSS-drawn pixel creature
- Three stat bars: Hunger, Happiness, Energy (0–100)
- Buttons: Feed (+20 hunger, -5 energy), Play (+20 happiness, -10 hunger, -15 energy), Sleep (+30 energy, -5 hunger)
- Mood text updates based on stats
- Fully keyboard accessible with ARIA labels
- Responsive layout (works from 360px wide)

## How to Run
Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or internet required.

## Files
- `index.html` – main HTML structure
- `styles.css` – all styling and pixel art
- `app.js` – game logic and event listeners
- `README.md` – this file

## Constraints
- No external assets, packages, or network requests
- Plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Relative paths only
